messages:
Maya: Quick FYI - after upgrading the node SDK in the onboarding sampleapp I keep seeing empty request-id fields in logs when LOG_LEVEL=verbose. Repro on macbook. :eyes:
Sam: I can reproduce. Only when OTEL_ENABLED=1. Non-otel runs show x-request-id fine.
Irene: Which exact version? I thought the redact-on-verbose change landed last week.
Maya: @redwood/sdk-node v0.12.4 (pulled from main). Bisection points at the otel hook async header normalize change.
Sam: Minimal repro (order is important):
```js
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').otelHook())
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').logHook())
```
Sam: If otelHook runs first the logHook sometimes fires before req id is copied into context; with retry middleware you see blank reqid columns.
Maya: Also when REDACT_SENSITIVE=true the header `x-request-id` sometimes disappears completely from req during the retry flow (not just masked).
Irene: Sounds like a race: otelHook does async context set, logHook reads sync from req.ctx. Are we awaiting otel init anywhere?
Ajay: In the hook code otelHook does `getContext().then(c => setReqIdFromHeaders(c))` while logHook reads `req.ctx.reqId` immediately. If the promise hasn't resolved we log empty.
Maya: My quick repro steps: clone sampleapp, `LOG_LEVEL=verbose REDACT_SENSITIVE=true OTEL_ENABLED=1 npm start`, then `for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/text -d '{"q":"x"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'; done` and inspect stdout. Deterministic for me.
Sam: Local workaround: ensure telemetry is initialized before mounting logHook, e.g. `await telemetry.initialize()` on startup.
Ajay: I opened PR with two alternatives: 1) make otelHook init sync at bootstrap (best UX), or 2) make logHook fall back to `req.headers['x-request-id']` when ctx missing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/199 :thumbsup:
Irene: I prefer sync-ish otel init but we need to avoid blocking Private on-prem bootstraps. Add a config switch.
Maya: Added a small failing unit that reproduces race and attached stdout.
telemetry-bot: Created issue TW-5412: "node sdk: reqid missing when OTEL + verbose logs + retries"; linked PR #199.
devdeploy: Please hold hosted sampleapp rollout until this is resolved; could be a bad first-run experience.
Ajay: I'll gate behind `OTEL_INIT_SYNC=false` feature flag in sampleapp and add migration note in changelog. If CI green we'll merge behind flag and flip after smoke tests.
Sam: Thanks all for the fast triage.
Maya: I'll upload full logs and exact branch to TW-5412. :coffee:
